editorial_rules.geography: South Florida including Miami-Dade, Broward, Monroe, Palm Beach and the Everglades
editorial_rules.verification: Every clipping requires source link, event date and careful attribution; alleged crimes must be attributed to reporting or authorities

stories.label: MAY 20, 1927 / MIAMI BEACH / ARCHIVAL
stories.headline: AN ELEPHANT SERVED AS A GOLF TEE IN MIAMI BEACH
stories.summary: A State Archives photograph shows Rosie the elephant being used as a golf tee. Yes, an actual golfer, on an actual elephant, in Miami Beach.
stories.source_name: State Archives of Florida · Florida Memory

stories.label: OCT 6, 2026 / MIAMI INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT
stories.headline: CUSTOMS OFFICERS FOUND TEN LIVE SONGBIRDS IN A PASSENGER’S UNDERWEAR
stories.summary: According to a federal complaint reported by NBC 6, officers found the birds in plastic tubes sewn into a passenger’s underwear after a flight from Cuba.

stories.label: OCT 2, 2026 / KEY LARGO
stories.headline: TOM THE CAT, WEARING SUNGLASSES, APPEARED ON A BRICK OF COCAINE
stories.summary: Monroe County deputies reported a package found in mangroves near John Pennekamp Coral Reef State Park. It featured a cartoon cat in sunglasses. Other recovered packages bore the number 333.
